matching.rule: nearest valid future timestamp; ties choose earlier timestamp then smaller original frame index

training.selection: validation plant-macro mean of train-scale normalized target MAEs
training.loss: train-standardized equal-target Huber delta=1, inverse-plant-window weighting
training.scheduler: cosine to 0.1 of initial learning rate

statistics.unit: independent plant; average per-seed plant errors before resampling
statistics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within capacity and time comparison families separately

diagnostics.rapid_leaf_change: absolute leaf-count change per day exceeds the train 75th percentile for that task
diagnostics.stage: last observed M0 leaf-count-derived stage: early <=6, intermediate 7-10, mature >=11
diagnostics.continuous_associations: plant-level Spearman association with plant-bootstrap CI; descriptive, not causal

scope: Exploratory after M1 test inspection. No JEPA, no 3D, no deletion of hard plants, no M0/M1 modification. No fresh hyperparameter search.
